notes_for_editor: The 1928 date and the removed status rest on one NYS chapter page (Southern Tier list). The Summit-area marker (hmdb 89109) names 1928 towers on Mt. Tuscarora and in the Rice Brook area and does not mention Red House, so the accounts conflict and are not resolved. No removal date found, so no removal event. The 30-foot figure is the tower height as the page gives it; height_m was left out because the page does not say whether it runs to the cab floor. The Red House section of the NYS page has a stray line about a tower 'when it stood on Mt. Irvine' that may belong to another section; not used. The 1940s ski-brochure photo on that page is of the Bova tower, not Red House. Record coordinates not checked against a map. Possible leads: Allegany State Park Historical Society and Friends of Allegany State Park (guided-tour hosts), Olean Times Herald coverage of the park's fire towers.
